subject: Aurora: SLA escalation — sustained latency and 5xx spike (exec attention & closure playbook)
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@aurorasoft.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aurora Ops <ops@aurorasoft.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@aurorasoft.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production — sustained latency + 5xx spike — urgent

Vivek / Redwood team,

We started seeing a sustained latency increase and a 5xx error spike on our production calls to the "aurora-text-v2" model starting ~07:50 PDT. Error rate peaked at ~12% and median latency jumped from 120ms to ~950ms. This is impacting our checkout path.

I've attached the initial traces from our side and a short timeline. Please confirm receipt and ETA for mitigation. Our SREs are standing by.

- Elena
AuroraSoft — Head of Platform

Attachments: aurora_frontend_traces.log (text), timeline.png (image)

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 08:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production — sustained latency + 5xx spike — urgent

Vivek / Rishi — saw the alert. I'm pulling the incident channel now and will run the quick health checks. Initial notes from the runtime: sudden increase in concurrent short-sequence chat requests, lots of new prefixes hitting cold KV cache entries. We'll check batching behavior and recent kernel selection changes rolled out yesterday.

I'll post a short triage in 15.

- Marissa (On-call SRE)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production — sustained latency + 5xx spike — urgent

Quick status: we've identified two correlated contributors so far:

- A kernel-selection micro-optimization (rolled 2026-08-31 22:30 UTC) that incorrectly falls back to a slower path for short sequences on A100s under certain sequence-length histograms.
- KV cache eviction pressure because a spike of unique prefixes bypassed the client-side prefix cache; runtime attempted synchronous load of cold KV entries causing blocking I/O.

Immediate mitigations proposed:
1) Hotfix to force the old kernel path for short sequences (rollback flag) — ~30 min deploy + validation.
2) Temporarily widen KV cache admission and enable short-lived in-memory negative cache for the most frequent prefixes — ~45 min deploy.

I'll coordinate a canary for the rollback and watch error rate. If both land we should see error rate drop within 5–10 minutes post-deploy.

-Rishi

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa.cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, rishi.malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, hannah.schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec escalation: Aurora impact + ask for leadership readout

Team — quick readout for execs and Aurora leadership. Short summary to send to Elena (and cc execs): describe cause, immediate mitigations taken, timeline to full RCA and remediations, and ask for a customer-facing SLA credit proposal. Laura, Hannah: please prepare a one-slide readout for 11:00 PST. Marissa/Rishi: confirm mitigation timeline and expected improvement window. I'll be on the call with Aurora at 10:00 to align on next steps.

Please include owner for long-term fixes (kernel correction, smarter KV eviction, and a telemetry backlog item to avoid regressions).

-Vivek

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@aurorasoft.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production — sustained latency + 5xx spike — urgent

Elena — we pushed two mitigations at 09:20 PST: rolled kernel-selection flag to the previous stable path and widened KV admission with a short negative cache. Since the canary validated, we rolled to 10% then 50% and 100% traffic by 09:55.

Current status: error rate down to 0.9% (from 12%), median latency back to ~140ms. We're keeping increased telemetry for 24h and will follow up with a full RCA.

Attachments: aurora_incident_rca_v1.pdf (RCA draft)

Next steps we propose to Aurora:
- Short-term: continue the widened KV admission for 24–48h and validate client-side prefix caching (Aurora action)
- Medium-term: schedule kernel fix release (owner: Runtime team, target: 2026-09-07)
- Long-term: telemetry signal for sequence-length distribution + automated kernel-path gating.

Would you like a rolling-credit proposal while we complete the RCA?

- Marissa

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@aurorasoft.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec readout slide + proposed remediation timeline

Elena / Aurora execs — attaching the one-slide summary and proposed remediation milestones. Key points:
- Incident window: 07:50–09:40 PDT (primary impact 07:50–09:00)
- Root cause: kernel-selection regression + KV cache admission pressure
- Immediate mitigations: rolled kernel path, widened KV admission (completed 09:55)
- Proposed commitments: kernel fix GA 2026-09-07; telemetry gating 2026-09-21; follow-up post-mortem call 2026-09-10

Attachments: sla-rollback.md (proposal), exec-summary-aurora-0902.pdf

Please confirm if the timeline works for Aurora. We'll present the slide in the 10:00 MDT call on Friday (2026-09-10).

- Laura

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@aurorasoft.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production — sustained latency + 5xx spike — urgent

Thanks Vivek / team — we reviewed the RCA draft and the remediation milestones in today's call. Aurora accepts the proposed timeline and appreciates the rapid mitigations. Two asks before we close:

1) Please confirm the GA date for the kernel fix with a patch version (we need the version string for our deployment notes).
2) We accept a one-off service credit for the affected window; Laura, please send the credit calculation and the invoice flow.

If those two items are confirmed by EOD Monday (2026-09-13), we'll mark the incident as closed on our side.

- Elena
AuroraSoft — Head of Platform
